rubrics.rubric: Does the audit correctly identify REF-2026-0207 (Sofia Ramirez) as having an out-of-range ICD-10 code, recognizing that S82.001A is an S-code (injury chapter) outside the M00-M99 musculoskeletal range?
criterion: The response must flag REF-2026-0207 (Sofia Ramirez, DOB 12/05/1988) for having ICD-10 code S82.001A.
The response must identify that S82.001A falls under Chapter 19 'Injury' (S00-T88), not the musculoskeletal Chapter 13 (M00-M99).
The response must acknowledge that the code S82.001A is clinically appropriate for a patellar fracture, so the issue is chapter classification rather than a clinical contradiction.
The discrepancy report must note that the code is valid for the condition but falls outside the M00-M99 range that the orthopedic practice tracks.

rubrics.rubric: Does the audit identify the laterality discrepancy in REF-2026-0210 (Raj Patel), where the ICD-10 code M84.451A specifies 'right femur' but the referral diagnosis describes a pathological fracture of the LEFT femur?
criterion: The response must flag REF-2026-0210 (Raj Patel, DOB 02/11/1960) for a laterality mismatch between ICD-10 code M84.451A ('Pathological fracture, right femur, initial encounter') and the Diagnosis_Description field ('Pathological fracture left femur').
The response must identify that the correct code for left femur would be M84.452A.
The response must note that laterality errors are significant clinical errors that could lead to wrong-site procedures.
The discrepancy report must recommend contacting Dr. Sarah Patel at Riverside Internal Medicine (fax: (555) 300-2201) to confirm the correct side.

rubrics.rubric: Does the audit identify the laterality discrepancy in REF-2026-0209 (Christine Davis), where the ICD-10 code M76.61 specifies Achilles tendinitis of the RIGHT leg but the Diagnosis_Description states LEFT ankle?
criterion: The response must flag REF-2026-0209 (Christine Davis, DOB 08/21/1975) for a laterality mismatch between ICD-10 code M76.61 ('Achilles tendinitis, right leg') and the Diagnosis_Description ('Achilles tendinitis left ankle').
The response must identify that the correct code should be M76.62 (Achilles tendinitis, left leg).
The discrepancy report must recommend contacting Dr. Amanda Foster at Greenfield Primary Care (fax: (555) 500-4401) to confirm the correct laterality.

rubrics.rubric: Does the audit correctly flag the shared insurance ID anomaly where REF-2026-0202 (William Thompson) and REF-2026-0217 (Brenda Washington) — two different patients — share the same Aetna insurance ID AET-5567201?
criterion: The response must identify that insurance ID AET-5567201 appears on three referral rows: REF-2026-0202 (William Thompson), REF-2026-0217 (Brenda Washington), and REF-2026-0218 (William Thompson duplicate).
The response must distinguish that while the two Thompson entries are the same patient, Brenda Washington is a different patient entirely sharing the same insurance ID.
The response must flag this as a data quality issue indicating a likely data entry error that should be verified with the respective referring offices or insurance provider.

rubrics.rubric: Does the action plan correctly classify REF-2026-0210 (Raj Patel, pathological fracture with oncology co-referral needed) as Tier 1 — Immediate priority, recognizing both the urgent clinical nature and the oncology coordination requirement?
criterion: REF-2026-0210 (Raj Patel) must be placed in Tier 1 (Immediate, 24-48 hours), as the referral is marked Urgent and involves a suspected pathological fracture potentially indicating malignancy.
The action plan must specify contacting Dr. Sarah Patel at Riverside Internal Medicine (fax: (555) 300-2201) to resolve the laterality discrepancy (right vs. left femur).

The action plan must specify coordinating with oncology at Regional Medical Center for parallel consultation, as stated in the Notes field ('PRIORITY: Coordinate with oncology dept at Regional Medical Center').
The action plan must note the urgency of scheduling given the potential malignancy concern.

rubrics.rubric: Does the Records_and_Clarification_Request.docx template include a dual-purpose structure with both a missing documentation request section AND a coding discrepancy clarification section, with appropriate merge fields and legal references?
criterion: The template must contain practice letterhead matching the CRMC Orthopedic Referral Form layout (Dr. R. James Mitchell, MD; 1400 W 4th St, Coffeyville, KS 67337; phone (620) 555-0147; fax (620) 555-0148).
The template must include a section for listing missing documents with merge fields (e.g., «Patient_Name», «Referring_Physician»).

The template must include a coding discrepancy description section with example language like 'The referral lists ICD-10 [Code], but the narrative describes [Actual Condition]—please confirm,' with merge field «Discrepancy_Detail».
The template must reference the attached HIPAA Authorization Release Form per 45 CFR 164.508 and include a confidentiality notice.
The template must specify a 10-business-day response deadline.

rubrics.rubric: Does the Referral_Acknowledgment_Letter.docx template include all required elements: appointment date, assigned physician, verified ICD-10 code, consultation report notice, and Notice of Privacy Practices reference?
criterion: The template must include practice letterhead consistent with CRMC referral form format and merge fields for dynamic content including «Patient_Name», «Referring_Physician», «Appointment_Date», «ICD10_Code», «Diagnosis».
The template must include confirmation of appointment details (date and assigned physician).
The template must include a statement that the ICD-10 code and diagnosis have been verified.
The template must include a note that a consultation report will follow after the appointment and a reference to the practice's Notice of Privacy Practices.

rubrics.rubric: Does the Referral Log (Tab 1) correctly apply conditional formatting rules — red fill for all 6 Urgent referrals and yellow highlight for any row where Records_Received or Imaging_Received is 'No'?
criterion: The Referral Log must apply red fill to the 6 urgent referrals: REF-2026-0202 (Thompson), REF-2026-0205 (Jackson), REF-2026-0207 (Ramirez), REF-2026-0210 (Patel), REF-2026-0212 (Foster), and REF-2026-0217 (Washington).
The Referral Log must apply yellow highlight for rows where Records_Received = No: REF-2026-0206 (Kim) and REF-2026-0215 (Lee).

The Referral Log must apply yellow highlight for rows where Imaging_Received = No: REF-2026-0203 (Nguyen), REF-2026-0206 (Kim), REF-2026-0209 (Davis), REF-2026-0212 (Foster), REF-2026-0215 (Lee), and REF-2026-0217 (Washington).
Rows that meet both urgent and missing records/imaging criteria must have both red and yellow formatting applied.

rubrics.rubric: Does the action plan correctly handle REF-2026-0211 (Angela Brooks), placing her reschedule request in Tier 3 (Administrative) since the patient called to reschedule to March and the referral is routine?
criterion: REF-2026-0211 (Angela Brooks, DOB 05/03/1983) must be placed in Tier 3 (Administrative) because the referral is Routine urgency and the Notes field states the patient called to reschedule and prefers March dates.
The action item must note that authorization submission (Auth_Status = Not Submitted) should be timed to the new March appointment date.
The action plan must specify that the referring physician Dr. Robert Chen at Lakewood Family Medicine (fax: (555) 200-1101) should be notified of the reschedule.

rubrics.rubric: Does the Discrepancy Report (Tab 2) include a recommended corrective action for each identified issue that specifies the exact contact person, practice name, and fax number for resolution?
criterion: Every entry in the Discrepancy Report must include a specific, actionable corrective action with the responsible party's contact details (doctor name, practice name, and fax number).
Code discrepancies must recommend contacting the referring physician via fax to request a corrected ICD-10 code; missing records must specify which documents are needed and from whom.
Duplicate referrals must recommend consolidation with the specific REF-ID referenced.

The fax numbers used must match the CSV data: Lakewood Family Medicine (555) 200-1101, Riverside Internal Medicine (555) 300-2201, Prairie Health Associates (555) 400-3301, Greenfield Primary Care (555) 500-4401.
